name: MD AMED sampler
plain: Named AMED but the code is Heun with a sigma-weighted blend of derivatives, not an AMED midpoint network.
math: x_p=x+d·dt. w=min(0.5, 0.5·clamp(σ′/2,0.1,1)·damp). If w<0.01 return x_p. d_f=(1−w)d+w·d_p. x=x+d_f·dt. σ′≈0 or forced last step: return x0.
label: from code
surprise: Name says AMED; code has no learned or mean-value midpoint.

audit.note: Omits the cap and the end case. core/amed_sampler_core.py:60: w is clamped to at most 0.5, which matters since dampening can reach 2. Lines 93-94: at σ′≈0, or on the last step with force_euler, it returns x0. Lines 126-129: NaN/Inf reverts to x_p.
